intended_object: An internal step in a certificate-checking proof: the firing script (chip-firing) on the census graph that is decoded from the "rich witness" block data, built after the checker's boolean checks w1Checks/w2Checks have passed. Inferred from the docstring, its location in the ClosedRowProof/RichLeafSound module, and its use in RichLeafAssembly.
explanation: This definition just runs `piecewiseScript` from the census spec on data decoded from the library's own certificate format (`RichWitness`, `ExplicitPotential.Core`, `Context`). Its arguments include proofs that boolean checker functions return `true` (`hW1`, `hW2`). It is only used inside the soundness proof of the certificate checker (RichLeafSound.lean and RichLeafAssembly.lean). It is a device for verifying a computed certificate. No standard mathematical object in the literature corresponds to it, so there is nothing in Mathlib to compare it with.
